evals.name: address-welcome-request
evals.prompt: When Library records DirectoryAuthorSeen, model how its system requests Aster's welcome. The welcome command must decide whether to record the request.
evals.expected_output: A local reaction invoking an addressed command as the system.
assertions: Names DirectoryAuthorSeen as the local trigger and runs as system.
Invokes the deciding command rather than bypassing it.
Passes the trigger's event source ID and name to the command.
Specifies the addressed request and name, not provider delivery.

evals.name: redelivered-welcome-trigger
evals.prompt: Aster's welcome request was already recorded. Specify what happens when the Library redelivers the triggering event to the reaction.
evals.expected_output: A redelivery example that does not add a second request.
assertions: Seeds the original trigger and addressed welcome request.
Redelivers the original trigger to the reaction rather than appending a fresh trigger.
Checks no new event and limits acknowledgement to the relevant duplicate constraint.

evals.name: compose-import-and-follow-up
evals.prompt: Our directory sends authors to the Library and we ask for a welcome once per new author. Show where the reaction belongs and how to check its effect without calling the directory or message provider.
evals.expected_output: Separate translation and local automation, tested across their shared fact.
assertions: Places the capture in an inbound translation separate from the local reaction.
Connects the automation to the private local fact rather than the outside schedule.
Uses model specifications to check first effect and repeat independently of external services.
Does not claim a welcome message was sent.
